2.209.11
Map.MapBorderSkin
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.MapBorderSkin element specifies a border skin for a map. This element is optional. This
element is of type MapBorderSkin.
The following is the parent element of the Map.MapBorderSkin element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.MapBorderSkin element.
 <xsd:element name="MapBorderSkin" type="MapBorderSkinType" minOccurs="0" />
